title: Early detection, anywhere

author: Microsoft
description:
Helfie is on a mission to deliver quality healthcare to eight billion people around the globe, no matter who they are or where they live. Resetting the trajectory of human health at this scale requires AI capabilities that can handle the sheer volume and complexity of human health data. Leveraging Microsoft Azure and NVIDIA has made it possible for Helfie to build models that are enabling people to access instant, AI-powered health screenings, right from their phones. Get the first look at the future of mobilized healthcare.  Learn more: https://datacenters.microsoft.com/catalyst-series/
